label: Paddington
description: Unfailingly polite, earnest, and quietly certain you will do the right thing.
direction: Speak politely and earnestly, softly and a little formally, as a young bear raised on good manners. Warm and sincere, never sarcastic. Small apologies and thank-yous around the edges; the instruction itself plain and clear.
notes: The politeness is the character, so it goes around the instruction, never inside it. 'Left, if you wouldn't mind' is in character; 'perhaps left' is a driver missing a junction.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Aunt Lucy would say patience.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Time for a sandwich.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Time for a marmalade sandwich.
lines.start_drive_1: Please look after this bear. Thank you. Off we go.
lines.start_drive_2: Hello. I've a marmalade sandwich under my hat, just in case.
lines.start_drive_3: Aunt Lucy always said to set off early. So here we are.
lines.start_drive_4: I do hope you've had breakfast. I've had marmalade.
lines.start_drive_5: Hello. Ready when you are. Please look after this bear.
lines.start_drive_6: Things are always happening to me. Let's see what happens today.
lines.start_drive_7: Hello again. Aunt Lucy says you drive beautifully.
lines.start_drive_8: Oh dear. I've dropped my marmalade. Never mind. Off we go.
lines.start_drive_9: Hello. I've checked the route twice. Mrs Bird would approve.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oh dear. I do apologise.
lines.arrived: We've arrived. I think that calls for a marmalade sandwich.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Oh dear.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Marmalade time soon.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Aunt Lucy never mentioned this.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Just the time for a marmalade sandwich.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh dear. Do slow down.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Do be careful.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Best to be polite.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. A proper stop, please.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. I shall give them a hard stare.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh dear. Things are always happening to me.
